mechanism: Diclofenac inhibits renal prostaglandin synthesis, reducing renal perfusion and increasing dronedarone levels through impaired clearance; NSAIDs also increase cardiovascular and arrhythmia risk in patients receiving antiarrhythmics.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function closely, use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration, and monitor for dronedarone toxicity and arrhythmias.
